people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “So you, son of man: I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.
translations.bsb: As for you, O son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me.
